verdict.rationale: Using a paired tablet as a secondary display is a fair question for a desktop operating system, but the evidence pack never documents it. The nearest items are adjacent features: Snap layouts organize windows on one screen, 2-in-1 hardware and tablet/laptop mode switching describe the device itself, and accessory compatibility is generic. None of these describe extending the display to a separate paired tablet.

support.subject: As a designer, I can use a paired tablet device as a secondary display for creative apps
